name: Stablecoin Examiner Pack
outcome: Examiner-facing composition over three landed nodes: a GENIUS-shaped reserve disclosure conformance check (art-582), an independent Proof-of-Reserves recompute (art-584), and a sanctions-screening decision pinned to the exact versioned dataset it ran against (art-585). On-chain circulating supply enters as a DECLARED caller input, compared numerically against the issuer's reported outstanding-token count; it is informational, reaches no requirement verdict, and involves no network read. Reading that figure directly from a light client is a named follow-on, not part of this pack. Produces the evidence a stablecoin examination asks for; it is not a compliance certification and takes no position on solvency.
